officialSources.title: ISTA Mark-P-01 Copyright Policy and Procedure v2.0
officialSources.evidence: Pages 2-4 cover online materials. General principles require written specific-use permission; section A permits linking but provides no general reposting licence. The section B single-figure provision cannot safely be treated as an unrestricted online commercial-site logo/banner licence in light of section A and the commercial-use conditions. A separate ISTA-logo policy is referenced; no applicable permission for this exact composite banner was established.
